notes:
Topline: large national archives provider evaluating low-latency regional RAG search. Needs EU/UK data residency, multi-region routing with automatic failover to EU-Central; eventual on-prem footprint at two sites.

Key constraints and asks:
- Indexing scale: estimated 150M-300M documents; plan to store dense embeddings ~800M-1B vectors (hybrid sparse/dense).
- Latency: target median p95 <= 40ms for query+rerank in UK region; burst tolerance to 200 qps for critical search endpoints.
- Cost: cost-per-query budget ~ $0.002 - $0.01 depending on rerank depth; very sensitive to per-token and batching efficiency.
- Model preferences: open models preferred; will consider quantized vicuna/llama variants or Redwood-verified models. Require model pinning and deterministic rerank reproducibility.
- Routing/failover: prefer region-aware routing (UK-primary, EU-failover). Need runbooks for failover and smoke checks.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 7+ years, KMS integration for key management, contractual data residency (UK-only ingest for certain datasets).

Recent interactions (summary):
- 2026-01-10: Intro call (AE + SE) — scoping, high level architecture. Asked for reference designs for on-prem hybrid setup.
- 2026-01-25: Deep-dive with infra team (Fireflies ff_20260125_3301). Collected sample traffic patterns and retention requirement.
- 2026-02-02: POC kickoff; ingest pipeline demo and first 10M doc index (Fireflies ff_20260202_8482). POC metrics captured in perf-report doc.
- 2026-02-12: Security questionnaire submitted by Trinity; follow-up questions logged to SEC-3341.
- 2026-02-18: POC perf meeting; Redwood delivered runner scripts and quantization profile. Customer requested lower p95 via model routing + caching.

Customer quotes / tone:
- "We love the idea of unified runtime, but legal will not accept EU-fallback writing to non-UK buckets for 3rd-party datasets."
- "Cost math is make-or-break. If rerank doubles cost, we need automated suggestions to reduce depth per query."

POC outcomes so far (notes):
- Achieved median latencies ~28ms in EU staging for bare retrieval; full rerank with local quantized model currently 65-80ms — needs optimization.
- Batching and prefix KV caching reduced token cost by estimated 18% in test workload.
- Identified two hotspots: cross-region KV miss penalty and retriever scoring imbalance requiring rerank pruning.
